Problem Statement:
Given a number N, find the smallest number which is greater than N with the same digits in N. If N is the greatest digit print 'impossible'. 
Input Description:
Input Size : 1 <= N <= 1000000000000000000 
Output Description:
The smallest number which is greater than N with the same digits in N, or 'impossible' if N is the greatest digit. 
Sample Input:
123 
Sample Output:
132
